collection.title: Lexus LS Series LS 500 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Lexus LS Series LS 500 2017 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
